task_objective: Bound Ludusavi discovery verification with a 15-second timeout
design_decisions: Added _DISCOVERY_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 15.0 to discovery.py and applied it to subprocess.run. Caught subprocess.TimeoutExpired alongside OSError to return False. Kept timeout fixed and internal, without exposing it to public API.
results: Implementation passes all existing and new tests. Discovery probes will no longer hang indefinitely.
